rows.grounds: locative plural expressing location within thousands
compound of womb/source and mechanism or diagram, in locative plural
past passive participle indicating those who are afflicted or oppressed

items.question: What affliction characterizes beings within the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms?
premises: The scope is eighty-four thousand in number.
These thousands are womb-mechanisms serving as loci of existence.
Beings located in these womb-mechanisms are tormented.
items.inference: Existence across the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms is marked by torment.
uncertainties: The precise nuance of yoniyantra as diagram, device, or mechanism is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
